subject: EgoSocial status: baseline running, audio cue risk
body:
Hi Deshawn, Dmitri,

Status. Regeneration pipeline landed March 24 (four days late - the under-development warning in the repo was earned, we had to patch the generation script's config handling). EgoSoD baseline is now running: on the first 5k pairs we get 68.2% intervention-timing accuracy with the full social thinking graph, versus 61.5% for a vision-only ablation.

The risk: audio cues carry a lot of the signal, and about 12% of our extracted audio clips have sync drift from the ffmpeg extraction settings, which silently degrades the multimodal fusion. Quentin caught it because the audio-ablation gap shrank when it shouldn't have. Fix is a re-extraction pass with corrected timestamps, ~1 week of Wanjiru's time, which delays the synthetic pipeline's compositing stage.

Proposal: take the week now, keep April 17 for baseline numbers but on the corrected set only.

Freya
